title: Extract the IWRAM memory-helper vector
changes: Publish and serve the three authenticated European IWRAM memory-helper Thumb pointer words as a dedicated resource; the original guest retains selection, indexing and execution of mutable IWRAM code. All 12 bytes were unowned in the E172 sample.
validation: Source e190-helper-source-2muj949h authenticates the vector, reader windows and ROM code prefixes. Wine e190-helper-trace-wine-1jrexdnx observes all three reads; Wine e190-helper-wine-r9rce5o_ preserves the previous 121 resources, rejects coherent edits and validates altered sources, mirrored and mixed boundaries and three interpreter/native load-and-branch entries.

Wine e190-helper-scene-wine-94ao1rz2 matches full state, guest clock, video, OAM, dispatch and audio for 600 frames with all 12 source bytes altered. Wine e190-helper-cli-wine-h_owgk16 creates, reuses and verifies 123 matching files.
limitations: The first traced read occurred in native dispatch without exact instruction attribution; the other two used interpreter fallback. Other callers and live IWRAM paths, Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance measurements were performed.
